name: Mysterious Artifact
summary: The Mysterious Artifact is a relic guarded by Twilight's Hammer in Searing Gorge. It is sought for the Altar of Suntara in the Slag Pit.

sections.title: A Relic in the Hills
sections.body: Above a cave in the northwest hills of Searing Gorge, Twilight's Hammer Idolaters guard the Mysterious Artifact. The Altar of Suntara waits empty in the Slag Pit. The dying archaeologist asks you to carry the relic there and set it upon the altar.

faq.answer: Twilight's Hammer Idolaters guard the Mysterious Artifact in the northwest hills of Searing Gorge, above a cave.
Twilight's Hammer Idolaters guard the Mysterious Artifact in the hills of Searing Gorge.

faq.q: Where does it need to go?
faq.answer: The Mysterious Artifact belongs on the Altar of Suntara in the Slag Pit.
The dying archaeologist asks you to retrieve the relic and place it on the Altar of Suntara.
